craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Unspeakable-merely; private-ways close; concession is objectors best (UNC). Rejected: (a) pressing early → killed: press lands v39. Read aloud: OF-spir-IT, OF-na-TURE … EACH in-PRI-vate-WAYS.

lines: Of spirit, of nature — unspeakable, the mere word stays;
yet mind's own motions come conditioned, each in private ways.

reads_against.argmap: Unspeakable — of whom? → Denial stands; the concession is the objector's best case, pressed in v39.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
